Independent pharmacy analytics

Pharmacy business intelligence for independent pharmacies in Toronto and the GTA

Data Fort helps independent pharmacies use pharmacy dashboard reporting to understand refill retention, active patients, front-shop sales, inventory movement, payer or category trends, and monthly performance. The goal is practical independent pharmacy analytics that supports ownership, managers, and staff without adding more spreadsheet work.

Pain points

  • Refill behaviour and patient retention are hard to see from day-to-day reports.
  • Front-shop product performance is separate from prescription-side context.
  • Inventory movement, slow movers, and stockout risk require manual review.
  • Owners need a clearer monthly view of revenue, category mix, and operational pressure.

Sample metrics

  • Refill retention and likely-to-lapse patient groups.
  • Active patients, new patients, and returning patient patterns.
  • Front-shop revenue by category and product movement.
  • Inventory days on hand, slow movers, and high-value stock exposure.

Decisions enabled

  • Which patient segments may need refill reminders or follow-up.
  • Which front-shop categories deserve merchandising or promotion attention.
  • Which inventory groups are tying up cash or creating stockout risk.
  • Which monthly pharmacy business intelligence questions the team should review.

Local fit

For pharmacies across the GTA

Data Fort supports independent pharmacy analytics in Toronto, North York, Richmond Hill, Thornhill, Vaughan, Newmarket, Markham, Etobicoke, and Scarborough. Engagements can start with the pharmacy reports and exports already available.

Reporting outcome

From pharmacy reports to a clearer operating view

The result is a more usable view of refill retention, patient behaviour, front-shop performance, inventory reporting, sales reporting, and monthly business insights so decisions are not buried in disconnected files.
